The '''Pendal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Homon sector/Legends|Homon sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Pendal]].
